offline.localFirst: You can browse saved data while Asterism connects.
offline.title: Offline mode
offline.missing: GitHub CLI is missing. Saved data is available; install gh to refresh it.
offline.auth: GitHub sign-in is unavailable. Run gh auth login, then check the connection.
offline.network: GitHub is unavailable. Showing saved data; check the connection to retry.
offline.empty: No account data saved yet. Connect and choose repositories, or open Settings to recover older local data.
offline.storageHint: Preferences and projects are saved on this device. Repository data is separated by GitHub host and account.
offline.retention: Cache: up to 100 details and 16 MiB per account. History: up to 180 observations per series for 500 repositories. Older local JSON files are kept after migration.
offline.legacyHint: Older data has no account identity. View it separately, or import it only if it belongs to the connected account. Originals will be kept.
offline.clearHint: Removes saved summaries, catalog and details for this account. Keeps preferences, projects and star/download snapshots. Connect to fetch repository data again.
offline.create: Connect to GitHub to create repositories. No actions are queued while offline.
offline.noDetail: This detail is unavailable locally. Connect and open the repository once to save it for offline use.
offline.partial: Some data could not refresh. Saved values keep their original dates.
offline.traffic: GitHub provides a 14-day window. This app saves only the latest response, not an additional traffic history.
offline.storageError: Local data could not be read or saved. Your existing files were kept. Check the storage location and permissions in Settings, then retry.
